author: toketrain
body:
I was playing DTM, and I made a double chest full of iron armor for everyone to use. I filled it once, and Paolo975 took it all and threw it into the void. So I filled it again, but this time I put the chest in the iron room thinking he might not find it. He did, and he took all the iron out again and threw it into the void. I only got screenshots of the second time, but here they are:
http://imgur.com/a/c4L2B
Thanks
